intent: Make kuhy.duckdns.org serve each prerendered blog post's own HTML file instead of falling through to the SPA shell, so a shared post URL has the right title and link preview.
scope: Non-goal: no change to the reverse-proxy snippet, the compose stack, ports, or the build command
changes: try_files gains the middle term {path}/index.html, so a request for /blog/<slug> resolves to dist/blog/<slug>/index.html
Added a comment recording why the middle term is load-bearing, because its absence fails silently

verification.command: docker run caddy:2.8 with the old directive, curl each route
verification.evidence: /, /blog, /blog/hello-world and /blog/nope ALL returned <title>Krzysztof Rudnicki</title> — every post served as the landing page

verification.command: docker run caddy:2.8 with the new directive, curl each route
verification.evidence: /blog -> 'Blog — Krzysztof Rudnicki'; /blog/hello-world -> 'Hello, world — Krzysztof Rudnicki'; /blog/nope still falls back to the SPA shell as intended

risks: A directory in dist/ that shares a name with a client-side route would now win over the SPA fallback; today only /blog/<slug> directories exist, and they are exactly the ones that should win
The change only takes effect after setup_personal_website.sh rewrites the managed Caddyfile and restarts the container
rollback: Restore the single-term try_files line and rerun setup_personal_website.sh
After rollback, confirm / still serves and accept that blog posts revert to SPA-shell titles
